services.desc: Escape Charters offers affordable private fishing charters in Corpus Christi, Texas, with experienced guide Captain Ken Cotton. Whether you're planning a family fishing trip, an offshore adventure, or a relaxing day fishing the bays of the Texas Gulf Coast, our trips include quality fishing equipment, expert guidance, bottled water, ice, and fish cleaning. blurb: Escape Charters offers guided fishing trips offshore and in the bay around Corpus Christi and Port Aransas. They provide opportunities to catch species such as redfish, trout, drum, snapper, kingfish, wahoo, amberjack, jack crevalle, and shark. The company has been recognized with the 2023 Best of Corpus Christi Award in the Fishing Charter category.
